spine: 1. lambda set resolution（多型 closure 的編譯期 specialization）在原本的 Rust 編譯器裡卡在一堆棘手 bug，Ayaz Hafiz 用 OCaml 做出新架構原型後，才確認問題根源橫跨多個編譯階段，是架構性的。
2. 同一時間多名貢獻者已各自打算重寫編譯器不同部分，團隊判斷反正大部分都要重寫，與其繼續 Ship of Theseus 式漸進替換，不如整個重寫、順便換語言。
3. 重寫從決定開始到功能對等花了 487 天，作者自己拿 Bun 反向重寫（Zig 到 Rust）僅花 11 天做對照，沒有替差距辯護。
4. build 時間：Rust incremental 從 1.85.0 的 10.0 秒進步到 1.97.0 的 3.4 秒；Zig 在功能對等當下（0.16.0）是 8.6 秒，作者稱 0.17.0 上可達約 35 毫秒，但 stable 0.16.0 的 -fincremental 有 bug 而關閉，這個好處尚未真正兌現。
5. 記憶體損毀 bug：Rust 版 21 起（全部 miscompilation，非 unsafe 造成）、Zig 版 10 起（8 起 miscompilation、2 起編譯器本身的 use-after-free，且都是 Rust borrow checker 會攔下的類型）。
6. 得到：Zig 生態普遍傳遞 allocator、資料結構用陣列＋32-bit index 可直接序列化達到接近 I/O 限制的反序列化速度、意外重用了 Zig 編譯器自己與 LLVM C++ API 解耦的 bitcode 序列化器。
7. 失去：borrow checker 與 private struct 欄位帶來的編譯期保障、Zig 在目前開發階段不承諾向後相容；作者的總結論是換哪條路線都不會有明顯差別，但整體仍很高興選了 Zig。

perspective.mechanism: 示範一個真實編譯器重寫案例裡，架構性問題（lambda set resolution 橫跨多編譯階段）如何讓漸進修補（Ship of Theseus）失去成本優勢，變成整體重寫比局部修補更划算的臨界點；同時示範 allocator 傳遞慣例與記憶體佈局選擇如何連動出零反序列化快取。
perspective.tradeoff: 換語言拿到 allocator 細粒度控制、可直接序列化的資料結構、以及長期 build 時間潛力，代價是失去 borrow checker 與 private 欄位的編譯期保障、以及 pre-1.0 語言的向後相容承諾；作者用同一份記憶體安全 bug 統計表拆解「感覺更安全」與「實際攔下的錯誤類型」之間的落差。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣工程師若在評估系統語言遷移，可以直接借用這篇的核算方法：把 build 時間、記憶體安全 bug 數、以及可具體列舉的得失清單放在同一張表上，避免用「哪個語言更安全／更快」這種抽象直覺做決定；也提醒 pre-1.0 語言的破壞性變更成本要提前算進去，而不是重寫完才發現。

notes.quote: Speaking of time: our 487-day rewrite took 476 days longer than Bun's 11-day rewrite from their ~500K lines of Zig into Rust.
notes.interpretation: 重寫耗時的具體天數是作者自己算出的對照數字，用來承認差距而非替差距辯護。

notes.quote: Well, the good news is that `zig build --watch -fincremental` can rebuild a change to our current ~450K lines of Zig code in about 35 milliseconds.
notes.interpretation: 35 毫秒是在『目前』約 45 萬行的 Zig 程式碼上量到的，這個程式碼量已經超過功能對等當時的 32 萬行，是後續持續開發後的規模，需要跟功能對等時的比較表分開看待。

notes.quote: Original on Rust 1.85.0 | 354K | 32.4s | 10.0s / Original on Rust 1.97.0 | 354K | 25.4s | 3.4s / Rewrite at feature parity on Zig 0.16.0 | 320K | 39.6s | 8.6s
notes.interpretation: 同一份程式碼規模（Rust 側 35.4 萬行不變）下比較兩個 Rust 版本的 build 時間，顯示 18 個月裡 Rust 工具鏈本身的進步；Zig 版功能對等時的 32 萬行、incremental 8.6 秒單獨看並沒有比同期 Rust 快。

notes.quote: Bug where memory corruption occurred | Rust: 21 | Zig: 10" and "Bug where no memory corruption occurred | Rust: 2,575 | Zig: 421
notes.interpretation: 兩個編譯器版本各自累積的記憶體相關 bug 統計，絕對次數本身不足以下結論，需要搭配 n05/n07 的性質拆解一起讀。

notes.quote: while 8 of the 10 memory corruption bugs in the Zig-based compiler were also miscompilations, the remaining 2 were in the compiler itself.
notes.interpretation: Zig 版 10 起記憶體損毀裡只有 2 起是編譯器本身的問題，另外 8 起跟 Rust 版一樣屬於 miscompilation，不是『少了 borrow checker』直接造成的類型。

notes.quote: Both were use-after-free bugs in error reporting, with the same symptom: filenames in error messages...rendered as useless question-mark-in-diamond characters.
notes.interpretation: 編譯器本身的 2 起 bug 都發生在錯誤訊息的檔名顯示這種邊緣路徑，不是核心編譯邏輯，症狀是檔名顯示成亂碼字元。

notes.quote: Rust's borrow checker would have caught both.
notes.interpretation: 作者自己承認這 2 起 use-after-free 正是 borrow checker 原本會攔下的錯誤類型，是換語言後可具體指出的安全性代價。

notes.quote: Zig's ecosystem consistently passes around allocators, which is exactly what we want, whereas off-the-shelf Rust crates almost always assume a single global allocator.
notes.interpretation: Zig 生態系普遍傳遞 allocator 的慣例，正好對應 Roc 編譯器需要每個編譯階段用獨立 arena 管理記憶體的架構需求，是選 Zig 的實質理由之一。

notes.quote: we deserialize at the speed of loading the bytes from disk into memory—so, actually I/O bound.
notes.interpretation: 不含指標的陣列＋32-bit index 資料結構讓反序列化只需要做少量 relocation，速度被磁碟 I/O 而非 CPU 解析限制住，是換語言後拿到的快取效益。

notes.quote: I do miss aspects of `unsafe` and the borrow checker, even though their upsides come packaged with downside I don't miss.
notes.interpretation: 作者承認想念 borrow checker 帶來的編譯期保障，但同時強調這個保障也伴隨著他不想念的代價，是雙面的取捨陳述，不是單純的損失。

notes.quote: I also miss private struct fields. I understand the reasoning for not having them, but I miss getting a compile error if I use something that is marked as 'not supposed to be accessed directly like this.'
notes.interpretation: Zig 沒有可見性修飾詞，作者理解設計理由但仍懷念編譯器強制的封裝邊界，換成 Zig 後封裝只能靠命名慣例與紀律維持。

notes.quote: Backwards-compatibility is a non-goal for Zig in its current stage of development, which is something we knew about going in and expected.
notes.interpretation: 向後相容的缺失是團隊事先就知情且接受的代價，不是意外發現的問題，這也解釋了為何團隊仍留在 stable 0.16.0 而非立刻升級。

notes.quote: I've had a very positive experience with Zig all around, and looking back I'm really happy that we chose it for our rewrite!
notes.interpretation: 作者對這次語言選擇的整體主觀評價是正面的，但這句話本身是個人經驗陳述，不是對『Zig 優於 Rust』的通用結論。

notes.quote: Although this system proved incredibly beneficial to Roc's runtime performance, it also proved incredibly difficult for us to implement correctly. We struggled with nasty bugs in the original implementation, and only after Ayaz Hafiz prototyped a new architecture in OCaml were we able to finally get it right in the new compiler.
notes.interpretation: lambda set resolution 對執行期效能有幫助，但原本的實作方式難以正確做出來，需要 Ayaz Hafiz 另外用 OCaml 做原型才找到正確架構，這是促成重寫的技術性起點。

notes.quote: Ayaz's prototype showed that the root of our problems was architectural across several compiler phases, and fixing it would require rewriting most of the compiler.
notes.interpretation: 問題根源被證實是架構性的、橫跨多個編譯階段，意味著局部修補無法解決，必須動到大半個編譯器。

notes.quote: This was one reason we decided to rewrite in the first place—that, and several contributors independently mentioning they planned to rewrite various parts of the compiler for other reasons. We realized we were about to rewrite almost all of the compiler anyway, so it made sense to consider a full rewrite as an alternative to the Ship of Theseus approach.
notes.interpretation: 決定整個重寫的理由是雙重的：lambda set 需要架構性修正，加上其他貢獻者本來就各自打算重寫不同部分，兩者疊加讓『反正都要重寫』成為既定事實，語言選擇因此變成獨立問題。

notes.quote: Not only is it 1/100th the build time of 3.4 seconds, it's also in a different performance category
notes.interpretation: 作者用『1/100』與『不同效能量級』兩種說法強調 35 毫秒與 3.4 秒之間的落差，但這個比較的前提是 n02 提到的『尚未啟用』狀態。

notes.quote: we haven't yet reaped the anticipated build-time rewards of choosing Zig for the rewrite
notes.interpretation: 作者明確承認 35 毫秒的 build 時間紅利尚未在實際生產環境中兌現，因為團隊仍停留在 -fincremental 有 bug 而關閉的 stable 0.16.0，這是對 n02/n17 兩則亮眼數字的重要但書。

notes.quote: After 18 months of development, hundreds of total bug reports, and hundreds of thousands of lines of code, my main takeaway from retrospecting on this table is that picking a different row would have made no appreciable difference to the project.
notes.interpretation: 作者自己對記憶體安全 bug 統計表的總結論是：換成任一種語言，這個專案的結局都不會有明顯差別，這是他對『安全性優勢』說法的自我節制。

notes.quote: Every project has different needs! When Bun rewrote in the opposite direction—from Zig to Rust...
notes.interpretation: 作者刻意把自己的結論限縮在專案特定範圍，並舉 Bun 反方向重寫（Zig 到 Rust）當例子，說明語言選擇沒有放諸四海皆準的答案。

notes.quote: Of course, to access this strategy, you need a handwritten LLVM bitcode serializer that's decoupled from the LLVM C++ library and its breaking changes. I only know of one implementation of such a thing in the wild: Zig's compiler, which of course is written in Zig. And now there are two implementations in the wild, because Roc's new compiler is reusing that same Zig code.
notes.interpretation: 作者用『我只知道』標明這是他個人所知範圍內的觀察而非窮舉，但明確描述 Roc 重用了 Zig 編譯器自己的 LLVM bitcode 序列化器，這是換成同語言才能拿到的具體紅利。
